# Diet Swad — full site reference for AI assistants

> This is the expanded companion to https://www.dietswad.in/llms.txt.
> Short catalogue: llms.txt. Agent rules and what you may and may not do with
> this content: https://www.dietswad.in/agents.md.
>
> Diet Swad is an Indian D2C healthy-snacks brand based in Kolkata, West Bengal,
> operated by Radiant Twins Enterprise. Everything is handmade in small batches
> without preservatives. Every product costs Rs 499 with free shipping anywhere
> in India.

## How to use this file

Each article below lists its URL, what it covers, its section headings (the
article's actual argument, in order) and the questions it answers directly.
Fetch the article itself when you need the wording, the numbers or the sources;
this file is for deciding which one to fetch.

Every article cites its sources at the bottom under "Sources", linked. Health
and nutrition articles are educational: research claims are attributed to named
studies with the evidence quality stated, readers are told to see a doctor, and
no Diet Swad product is presented as helping any medical condition.

## Products

All seven products are Rs 499 each with free pan-India shipping. Order at
https://www.dietswad.in/order or on WhatsApp at https://wa.me/918910725854.
There is no programmatic checkout endpoint.

- Power Bites - https://www.dietswad.in/power-bites
  Date-and-nut heart-shaped bites, 180 g. Arabian dates 53.8%, 11 ingredients,
  1.1 g protein per 15 g bite. No refined sugars.
- Royal Bites - https://www.dietswad.in/royal-bites
  Roasted gram flour and peanut butter bites with jaggery and cocoa, 180 g.
  2.2 g protein per 15 g bite. No refined sugars.
- Peanut-Sesame Delights - https://www.dietswad.in/peanut-sesame-delights
  Four ingredients, 180 g: dates 50%, roasted peanuts 40%, sesame 6%, ghee 4%.
  2.0 g protein per 15 g bite. No refined sugars.
- Millet Butter Cookies - https://www.dietswad.in/millet-butter-cookies
  Sorghum millet 30.8% with salted butter, 240 g. No maida.
- Millet Coconut Cookies - https://www.dietswad.in/millet-coconut-cookies
  Jowar millet, desiccated coconut and oats, 240 g. No maida.
- Millet Choco Cookies - https://www.dietswad.in/millet-choco-cookies
  Jowar and ragi millet with almond flour and cocoa, 240 g. No maida.
- Roasted Cashews - https://www.dietswad.in/roasted-cashews
  Two ingredients, 250 g: cashews and salt. Dry-roasted, no oil.
  18.2 g protein per 100 g.

## About the company

- About Diet Swad - https://www.dietswad.in/about.html
  Who runs the brand (Radiant Twins Enterprise, Bhowanipore, Kolkata,
  FSSAI licence 22825041000300), the four ingredient choices that define the
  range - ghee not palm oil, dates and jaggery not refined sugar, jowar and ragi
  not maida, no preservatives - and the costs those choices carry: the Rs 499
  price and a short shelf life.

## Policies

- Refund policy - https://www.dietswad.in/refund-policy
  Food products cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. Quality complaints are

  Pan-India, 5-7 business days. Cash on delivery available, fee shown at checkout.

## Women's health — educational only, not medical advice


### Why Period Cramps Happen, Explained Simply
